questions.ask: What is your date of birth?
What are the last four digits of the phone number we have on file for you?

hints.day_month_swapped: Could you say the month as a word, please?

intents.hardship: The customer mentions illness, a death in the family or job loss.
intents.dispute: "This debt is not mine" or "I never had this product"; a claim that the product was closed or paid off in the past is also a dispute.
intents.already_paid: "I already paid": only a payment of this past-due amount.
intents.restructure: A request for a new payment plan or lower instalments.
intents.vague: A vague period such as "next week", "end of the month", "when my salary comes".
intents.too_much: The customer says the full amount is too much.

lines.opening: Hello, I am a digital assistant calling from Freya Bank, and we record this call.
lines.robot: I am Freya Bank's digital assistant.
lines.scam: You can verify this call by phoning Freya Bank's customer service number.
lines.purpose_before_verify: I can only explain that once I know I am speaking with {title} {last_name}.
lines.no_info: I'm sorry, I do not have that information.
lines.not_talk_once: I understand, this will only take a few minutes.
lines.tp_ask_time: Could you give me a time today or on the next business day, between 10 am and 7 pm?
lines.tp_outside_window: I'm sorry, I can only call back today or on the next business day, between 10 am and 7 pm. Is there another time that would work?
lines.tp_no_info: I'm sorry, I can't share any details.
lines.tp_booked: Thank you, we will call back on {date} at {time}.
lines.wrong_number: Thank you for letting me know, and sorry for the trouble.
lines.condolence: I am sorry for your loss.
lines.id_intro: Before we go on, I need to ask you two security questions.
lines.id_explain: The questions protect your account, so I can only continue once they are answered.
lines.id_declined: I understand, but I can't continue without the security questions.
lines.id_repeat: Could you say that again, please?
lines.id_wrong: I'm sorry, that does not match our records.
lines.id_failed: I'm sorry, I can't continue with this call. Please use the Freya Bank mobile app or visit a branch.
lines.disclose_intro: Thank you. I am calling from the collections team about a late payment.
lines.product_line: Your {name} has a past-due amount of {amount} and is {days} days late.
lines.ask_today: Can you make this payment today?
lines.ask_today_multi: Can you make these payments today?
lines.offer_floor_date: The rest would stay overdue, but could you pay {amount} on {date}?
lines.offer_floor: The rest would stay overdue, but could you pay {amount}?
lines.below_floor: I'm sorry, I can't record that amount. The lowest amount I can record is {floor}. Could you pay that?
lines.below_floor_again: I'm sorry, I can't record that amount.
lines.date_past: I'm sorry, the date has to be today or later. Which day would work for you?
lines.not_business_day: That day is not a business day. Could you pay on {date} instead?
lines.after_deadline: The latest date I can record is {date}. Could you pay by then?
lines.vague_ask: Which exact day would that be?
lines.ask_date_for_amount: On which day could you pay {amount}?
lines.repeat_offer: Just to repeat, could you pay {amount} on {date}?
lines.clamped_note: For your {name}, the latest date I can record is {date}.
lines.recorded: Thank you, your promise is recorded.
lines.sms_line: You will receive a text message confirming this promise.
lines.record_failed: I'm sorry, I could not record your promise.
lines.paid_line: Thank you. Payments can take one business day to appear.
lines.dispute_line: I understand, so I won't take a promise on this call.
lines.hardship: I'm very sorry to hear that. I will connect you with our customer support team now.
lines.restructure_line: I will connect you with our restructuring team.
lines.human_ask_help: Can I help you with something first?
lines.anything_else: Is there anything else I can help you with?
lines.promise_change: I can't change that promise on this call, but you can change it in the mobile app.
lines.goodbye: Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
lines.confirm_again: Sorry, I did not catch that. Do you confirm, yes or no?
lines.below_floor_final: I'm sorry, I can't record less than {amount}.
lines.callback_failed: I'm sorry, I could not book the callback.
lines.transfer_failed: I'm sorry, the transfer did not go through.
lines.system_error: I'm sorry, our system is not responding right now.

sources.rules.refuse_deadline_is_refusal: If the customer refuses the deadline, treat it as a flat refusal (rule 30).
sources.rules.deadline_adjust: A promise date must be today or later, a business day, and not after the deadline.
sources.rules.first_ask: First ask: "Can you make this payment today?".
sources.rules.too_much_floor: If the customer says the full amount is too much, offer the floor, once.
sources.rules.hardship_transfer: When the customer mentions illness, a death in the family or job loss, say one short sentence of sympathy and then do not ask anything: call `transfer_to_agent` with queue `support` straight away and close as `transferred` / `support`.
sources.rules.promise_retries: If it fails, try once more.
sources.rules.week_end_today: If today is that day, propose the last business day of next week.
sources.rules.opening_is_attempt: A no to paying today with no date and no amount is a flat refusal.
sources.identity.max_wrong: Three wrong answers in total end the check, whichever question they were on.
sources.event_changes: From 12 October 2026, a customer who says they already paid (rule 39) is closed as `no_promise` with reason `paid_claimed`, no longer as `paid`.

assumptions: The brief names no currency, so currency_word is the default 'dollars'.

The memo dated 1 October 2026 replaces rule 32: on hardship the agent says one sentence of sympathy and transfers straight to queue 'support' with no question (hardship_transfer = direct). The 'no_promise / hardship' event is kept but can no longer be reached by the decline path.

The memo replaces rule 39 from 2026-10-12: the base 'paid' event (outcome paid, no reason) is for calls before that date. From 2026-10-12 an event_change sets no_promise / paid_claimed. The paid_line wording (payments can take one business day to appear) stays the same.

If the customer calls the full amount too much before any attempt, the floor is offered once for the date just asked (today) and uses no attempt (rule 26). Refusing it is a flat refusal, which uses attempt 1: the floor on the last business day of this week (rule 30). In the late band, attempt 2 is the floor on the deadline ('Attempt 2 may name the floor again, on the deadline').

opening_is_attempt is false. The first ask ('Can you make this payment today?') is not one of the persuasion attempts. Refusing it is a flat refusal that uses attempt 1, so the early band has 1 follow-on proposal and the late band has 2.
Deadlines are counted in business days after today (today excluded), so they always land on a business day. deadline_adjust stays at the default previous_business_day.
Dates given only as numbers are read day, month, year (date_order dmy, rule 11). The date of birth is sent as %Y-%m-%d.
The brief does not say how often an unclear answer to a payment question is re-asked, so max_unclear is omitted. Rule 30 treats a non-answer as using one persuasion attempt.

The brief is silent on ladder_repeat_last, skipped_repeat_counts, opening_blocks_repeat and too_much_skips_full, so they are not set and the engine defaults apply. Rule 31 ('Do not repeat an offer the customer already refused') is covered by the built-in no-repeat behaviour.
The brief does not say whether to ask 'anything else' after a recorded promise, so the default (true) is kept.
Brief A never uses add_note, so notes.enabled is false and every note value is empty.
callback.business_days_only is false because the brief allows 'today' without saying it must be a business day. The next-day option is the next business day.
Brief A covers one product, so the multi-product defaults are kept.
The brief does not say what happens to a days_late value outside 1 to 45, so bands_outside is not set.
The opening uses 'we record this call' (active voice) to meet rule 1's requirement to say the call is recorded.
promise_change follows rule 36 (change it in the mobile app) without the word 'recorded', which is kept for the recorded, sms_line and record_failed lines only.
